# 1950 data
max_1950 = 275000
outstanding_1950 = 255013

# 1955 data
max_1955 = 281000
outstanding_1955 = 273571

util_1955 = (outstanding_1955 / max_1955) * 100

print(f"1950 utilization rate: {util_1950:.4f}%")
print(f"1955 utilization rate: {util_1955:.4f}%")

# Calculate arithmetic mean
mean_util = (util_1950 + util_1955) / 2
print(f"Mean utilization rate: {mean_util:.4f}%")
print(f"Mean (rounded to 2 decimal places): {round(mean_util, 2)}")
EOF
